{{Disambig|Fallen}}

==Enemies==
'''Fallen''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Awakened Fallen King]], the major boss of the [[Hidden Wave]]
*[[Corrupted Fallen]], a quick enemy that first appears on Wave 21 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Corrupted Fallen/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Fallen]], a fast enemy that first appears on Wave 14 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Fallen/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Fallen Angel]], a high health flying enemy that first appears on Wave 33 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Fallen Angel/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Fallen Dreg]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 5 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Fallen Dreg/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Fallen Giant]], a high health enemy that first appears on Wave 16 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Fallen Giant/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Fallen Guardian]], a guardian enemy that first appears on Wave 39 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Fallen Guardian/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Fallen Guardian (Legacy)]], a guardian enemy that first appears on Wave 40 in [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode
*[[Fallen Hazmat]], a high defense enemy that wears a hazmat suit that first appears on Wave 17 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Fallen Hazmat/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Fallen Hero]], a high health enemy that first appears on Wave 25 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Fallen Hero/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Fallen Hero (Legacy)]], a high health enemy that first appears on Wave 39 in [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode
*[[Fallen Honor Guard]], a high health enemy with the ability to stun towers that first appears on Wave 35 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Fallen Honor Guard/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Fallen Jester]], an enemy that can buff other enemies, that first appears on Wave 24 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Fallen Jester/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Fallen King]], a major boss that first appears on Wave 40 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
*[[Fallen King (Legacy)]], a major boss that first appears on Wave 40 in [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode
*[[Fallen Necromancer]], a summoner enemy that first appears on Wave 20 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Fallen Necromancer/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Fallen Rusher]], a very fast enemy that first appears on Wave 28 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Fallen Rusher/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Fallen Seraph]], a quick flying enemy that first appears on Wave 22 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Fallen Seraph/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Fallen Shield]], a high health enemy that speeds up upon losing all of its shield health that first appears on Wave 30 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Fallen Shield/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Fallen Skeleton]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 5 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode and Wave 10 in [[Badlands II]]
**[[Fallen Skeleton/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Fallen Soul]], a hidden enemy that first appears on Wave 13 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Fallen Soul/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Fallen Squire]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 7 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Fallen Squire/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Fallen Summoner]], a high health summoner that becomes hidden at half health that first appears on Wave 37 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Fallen Summoner/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Fallen Tank]], a fast high health enemy that first appears on Wave 31 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Fallen Tank/Advanced Stats]]

It can also refer to these enemies which are either removed or only accessible if summoned by the player in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode:
*[[Fallen Reaper]], a summoner enemy that first appeared on Wave 21 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode
*[[Fallen Rusher (Legacy)]], an extremely swift enemy that first appeared on Wave 27 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode
*[[Fallen Soul (Legacy)]], an enemy which applies the [[Fatigue Debuff]] that could have been summoned by the [[Fallen Reaper]] from Wave 25 onwards in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode
*[[Fallen Swordmaster]], a major boss that first appeared on Wave 47 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode
*[[Fallen Titan]], a high health enemy that attacks towers with a hammer, which first appeared on Wave 31 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode
*[[Nuclear Fallen King]], a major boss that first appeared on Wave 40 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode in [[Polluted Wasteland]]

It can also refer to these event enemies:
*[[Fallen Hero (The Heights)]], a high health enemy that first appeared on Wave 15 in the [[The Heights]]
